findings.failedLink: Command identity is derived from operation, subject and argument values, then retained indefinitely. Only Notifications/Backup have repeat exceptions. A later operation returning to earlier values is treated as an already completed invocation.
findings.requiredChange: Separate invocation identity from argument equality, retaining duplicate protection for the same invocation while allowing subsequent legitimate operations.
findings.smallestProof: Exercise Settings Light → Dark → Light and crash reporting off → on → off through RootUiAdapter and a real production manager. Assert the final persisted and effective value. Also perform transition → undo → transition → undo on one batch.
findings.title: Lifetime command deduplication suppresses legitimate later operations

findings.failedLink: The delete command only deletes the zone row. The test explicitly asserts that an active batch's original Assigned placement remains unchanged, contrary to the required reassignment/unassigned resolution.
findings.requiredChange: Resolve current assignments transactionally with zone deletion and preserve historical snapshot text separately.
findings.smallestProof: Delete a zone occupied by an active batch through production. Assert the batch becomes explicitly unassigned or reassigned, while terminal history retains the original zone-name snapshot.
findings.title: Deleting a growing zone leaves active batches assigned to a nonexistent zone

findings.failedLink: Production snapshots default to offline=true and catalog explicitly sets it. No production connectivity projection sets it false. adPlacementRequestOrNull immediately returns null when offline, preventing privacy resolution, first consent and eligible ad loading.
findings.requiredChange: Separate offline-capable local content from actual connectivity/advertising eligibility and wire the latter into production.
findings.smallestProof: Use real production Catalog/History snapshots with an injected online host and deterministic eligible privacy response. Assert that the placement request reaches the runtime, protected consent precedes initialization, and only the approved inline position is used.
findings.title: Production advertising eligibility is unreachable

findings.failedLink: Daily scheduling counts work already due at reconciliation time, so future work becoming due while the app remains unopened need not receive a summary. Delivery is one-shot and does not arrange the next useful summary. Environment broadcasts only record signals consumed during graph construction. Time-zone reconciliation does not invoke the manager operation that rewrites stored CivilTime zones.
findings.requiredChange: Provide a lifecycle-safe delivery/reconciliation path, connect time-zone changes to persisted civil schedules, and verify actual receiver/Application ordering.
findings.smallestProof: Without reopening the app, advance from future work to two daily delivery windows; assert useful summaries and no empty summary. Reboot and change time zone with a civil action plus an active soak; assert rescheduling completes and civil/elapsed semantics diverge correctly.
findings.title: Reminder scheduling does not implement all delivery and environment-change branches

findings.failedLink: ReminderReconciler returns failed registrations in its result; SnapshotReminderReconciliationPort discards that result. Tests instead use a port that throws, so their rollback branch differs from production. Photos are swapped and their previous directory removed before database/settings replacement, with no inspected durable recovery journal spanning those resources.
findings.requiredChange: Propagate or explicitly handle coordinator failures at the transactional boundary and implement/test durable recovery for interrupted replacement.
findings.smallestProof: Use the real coordinator with a failing ReminderDriver during restore/reset and assert the required failure/rollback outcome. Terminate between photo swap and database commit, reopen, and assert one complete consistent workspace rather than mixed generations.
findings.title: Restore/reset ignores real reminder failures and lacks proven crash-safe multi-resource recovery

findings.failedLink: Privacy runCatching paths turn cancellation into ordinary failure/disabled state. Erase compensation lacks the NonCancellable protection used by replacement restore. Store busy/inFlight cleanup is after suspension without finally, so cancellation can bypass cleanup.
findings.requiredChange: Preserve cancellation and protect necessary compensation/cleanup with explicit finally or cancellation-safe boundaries.
findings.smallestProof: Cancel privacy fetch and erase at suspension boundaries; assert CancellationException propagation, unchanged/restored data and usable retry state.
findings.title: Cancellation handling is inconsistent across production boundaries

findings.failedLink: The runtime report explicitly leaves TalkBack traversal/spoken order unverified. Accessibility tests mainly search source text. Bounded manual Android flows and passing host tests do not establish the complete current native matrix. The macOS workflow has no executed receipt here and its listed Kotlin compilation targets cover simulator Arm64 rather than explicitly both declared iOS targets.
findings.requiredChange: Supply missing executed platform evidence and retain the distinction between compilation, runtime acceptance and conditional external release configuration.
findings.smallestProof: Execute current-APK accessibility/keyboard and notification/process-restart cases with observable assertions; obtain macOS build/linkage/native runtime receipts for the declared iOS scope.
findings.title: Native runtime and accessibility evidence remains incomplete

findings.failedLink: Many component AC tests pass a ready-made successful snapshot into FakeManager. Some persistence tests construct the expected terminal/repeated record before saving it. The actual restart fixture is a planned batch despite its test name mentioning history. Separate manager tests provide useful partial proof but do not substantiate every listed component, failure and restart surface.
findings.requiredChange: Add or strengthen only the missing behavior assertions; reuse the current passing matrix without treating AC-prefixed names or zero exit codes as acceptance.
findings.smallestProof: For each gap pair, drive the public production component/Store with real SQLite and deterministic platform ports, then assert the resulting model and persisted state. Reopen actual storage for restart claims. Test abandonment/repeat by invoking the operation rather than preconstructing its result.
findings.title: Several acceptance assertions bypass the production behavior they name

findings.smallestProof: Complete the missing screen-family/state-to-golden review against actual production fixtures, document remaining asset usage/provenance checks, and substantiate catalog source/range/content review. Do not infer runtime accessibility from screenshots.
